variants.name: 11.4 kg
variants.about_this_item:
A diet rich in whole fish delivers essential nutrients, like Omega fatty acids, naturally and in their most nourishing form. ACANA™ Pacifica is bursting with wild-caught herring, mackerel, flounder, hake, and rockfish that are delivered to our kitchen fresh or raw* from people we know and trust. Using WholePrey ratios of fish, organs, and bone, ACANA™ gives your dog everything they need in order to stay happy, healthy, and strong, with a delicious taste that they’ll love.

1. 70%** QUALITY ANIMAL INGREDIENTS | PROTEIN-RICH & NUTRIENT-DENSE
2. FIRST 3 INGREDIENTS FRESH OR RAW HERRING, MACKEREL & FLOUNDER
3. FREEZE-DRIED COATED FOR TASTE
4. PREBIOTICS AND FIBRE TO SUPPORT HEALTHY DIGESTION
5. VEGETABLES, FRUIT, BOTANICALS & NUTRIENTS
6. NO GRAIN INGREDIENTS***


*Our fresh ingredients use refrigeration as the sole method of preservation and our raw ingredients are frozen at the peak of freshness to preserve nutrients.
**Approximate and derived from the unprocessed state of the ingredients.
*** Produced in a facility that processes grains
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition

Raw whole herring (14%), raw whole mackerel (11%), raw flounder (9%), herring meal (7%), mackerel meal (7%), blue whiting meal (7%), whole green peas, whole red lentils, whole chickpeas, whole green lentils, fish oil (6%), raw whole hake (4.5%), raw whole rockfish (4.5%), whole pinto beans, whole yellow peas, pea starch, sunflower oil, lentil fiber, dried kelp, freeze-dried cod and liver, fresh whole pumpkin, fresh whole butternut squash, fresh whole carrots, fresh whole apples, fresh whole pears, fresh whole zucchini, dried chicory root, fresh kale, fresh spinach, fresh turnip greens, fresh beet greens, whole cranberries, whole blueberries, whole saskatoon berries, turmeric, milk thistle, burdock root, lavender, marshmallow root, rosehips.

Analytical constituents

Crude protein 35% Fat content 17% Crude fibre 6% Crude ash 7% Moisture 12% Calcium 1.3% Phosphorus 1% Omega-3 fatty acids* 2% Omega-6 fatty acids* 2% DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) 0.9% EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) 0.7%
